data.one_liner: Official Airwallex Flutter plugin for accepting payments on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides native UI components and APIs to accept card payments, e-wallets, Apple Pay, and Google Pay in Flutter applications. Supports localized payment sessions and multiple card brands.
use_when: You need to integrate Airwallex payments into your Flutter mobile application.
You want to support multiple payment methods including cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and major e-wallets.
avoid_when: You require web platform support (currently only Android and iOS are documented).
You are using a different payment gateway such as Stripe or Adyen.
strengths: Supports multiple popular payment methods (Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, E-Wallets).
Includes multi-language localization out of the box.
Supports both CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager on iOS.
weaknesses: Platform support is limited to Android and iOS.
Card payments require PCI-DSS compliance if integrating the Airwallex API without their Native UI.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. On iOS, Swift Package Manager can be enabled using 'flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager' if not using CocoaPods.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if your payment gateway is Stripe instead of Airwallex.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if your payment gateway is Adyen instead of Airwallex.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are selling digital goods via Apple App Store or Google Play Store billing instead of an external payment gateway.
